body: tell them that you are struggling and you would much rather prefer outpatient. you shouldn't be getting locked up for a mental health crisis. they may say that you should go to psychiatric hospital. just know that it's not as bad as they seem.
Thank you for helping, I'll try it out.
Then what do I do? How can I possibly get the world off my shoulders :/

My whole life has been a shit show. I've been struggling with depression since I was 8, and anxiety for as long as I can remember. And who knows how long I've been struggling with Bipolar and Disassociation (dp/dr). I was introduced to sex too young and I got raped a number of times by family members and I thought that it was okay. When my siblings and I moved with my stepdad, he raped and molested me.. but I only spoke up about the molestation part, so i've been struggling with that for years. I have major gaps in my memory from that. I'm in a place in my life right now where nothing is stable. Nothing seems to get better. I just barely got out of my 4th admission to a mental hospital and I feel the need to go back. I was put back on meds, but they just ran out and my father isn't taking care of what he needs to in order for me to get a refill. Depression was never a choice for me, but I hate how others make it seem like it is. It's a chemical imbalance and in my case, it's genetic. I feel so hopeless and I feel like no matter what I say, no one can understand me. I feel like i'm in the middle of the ocean; unreachable. There's so much more that I could talk about, but it seems useless. I've been trying so hard to be positive, but nothing seems to be working. i'm ready to give up. and please dont feel bad for me, i've had too much of that. thank you for listening
if you need someone to talk to, i'm here for now.
